mapper.select: SELECT id, artist_id, category_id, title, image_url, price, medium, orientation, dominant_color, dimensions, year, description, badge, stock_quantity, view_count, sold_count, is_active AS active, created_at, updated_at FROM artworks WHERE id = #{artworkId}
SELECT id, name, country, bio, avatar_url, created_at, updated_at FROM artists WHERE id = #{artistId}

SELECT arts.artwork_id, arts.size_id, arts.price_override, arts.is_available AS available FROM artwork_sizes arts JOIN sizes s ON arts.size_id = s.id WHERE arts.artwork_id = #{artworkId} AND s.name = #{sizeName}
SELECT id, name, price_delta, sort_order, created_at FROM sizes WHERE id = #{sizeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_no, user_id, status, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone, shipping_country, shipping_city, shipping_address_line1, shipping_address_line2, shipping_postal_code, payment_method, subtotal, shipping_fee, total, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{customerName}, #{customerEmail}, #{customerPhone}, #{shippingCountry}, #{shippingCity}, #{shippingAddressLine1}, #{shippingAddressLine2}, #{shippingPostalCode}, #{paymentMethod}, #{subtotal}, #{shippingFee}, #{total}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, artwork_id, artwork_title, artwork_image_url, artist_name, size_name, quantity, unit_price, subtotal, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{artworkId}, #{artworkTitle}, #{artworkImageUrl}, #{artistName}, #{sizeName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{subtotal}, #{createdAt} )
